page.layout: One page of text. At the top, a full-width dedication title in large type over four centred lines, then a greeting line, then the body of the dedication in one column with a woodcut initial at its start. Below the last line, at the right, the catchword. At the lower left, the gathering signature.

main_text.head: SERENISS° POTENTISSIMOQUE PRINCIPI, AC DOMINO NOSTRO, Iacobo, Dei Gratia, Magnæ Britanniæ, Franciæ & Hiberniæ Regi, FIDEI Defensori &c.
main_text.p: Quod pro suo iure Rex quivis faceret, ut Suorum animos, qui iustam suspicioni causam dederant, nova Iuramenti religione exploratos Sibi redderet: cum causa Matti[?] T.[?] subesset iustissima, ex Scelere post homines natos atrocissimo, & id nuper facere tentares: intercessum est a Papa Paulo, atque incursio facta in Ius Tuum, nec Tuum modo, sed commune Ius Regum omnium. Ea enim in Te unum experrecta jam, mox & in reliquos omnes convalescet. Agitur ergo communis Regum causa; cumque in Regibus, Rei Christianae praesidij plurimum sit, cum Illis, communis etiam Rei totius Christianae.

Iam, ubi in discrimen adducta causa Communitatis, Spectator nemo fit, Actor quisque: Ex communis enim Officij nexu, cuiusuis tum interest de Communitate, communis Militiae Sacramento obligare se statim: & ubi res omnium agitur,

page.notes: The woodcut initial is a decorative Q; the text after it reads "uod", joined as "Quod". The reference "Matti. T." is a superscript abbreviation whose exact letters are uncertain. A small "1" printed beside "SERENISS°" in the title was left out as a printer's mark. No marginal notes are printed on this page. The signature "A 2" stands at the foot as the gathering mark; no separate page number is printed.
